title: Alarms-to-Actions: Regression Sprint Log
content:
Purpose
This note is a compact, operational handoff from the biweekly regression alarms into concrete sprint action items. Intended for applied-ml engineers, SRE oncall, and the onboarding triage pair. Not a polished exec doc — working log.

Quick TL;DR (2 lines)
- Quality drift spike observed on 2026-04-05 for new model v2-qdq (high hallucination on Rerank promptset). Root hypothesis: quantization / tokenization mismatch + promptset edge cases.
- Immediate actions: hotfix rollback to v2-qd (non-quantized); run focused promptset augmentations + unit prompts to validate patch; schedule canary with KV-cache warm-up for next deploy.

Metrics snapshot (last 14 days)
- regression-alerts-fired: 7
- unique-promptsets-flagged: 5
- median-latency-change: +3.2% (p95 +1.1s on small-batch path)
- generation-quality-score (auto eval ensemble): dropped 12 pts on Rerank set A
- customer-impacting: 1 (internal sandbox usage, no prod customer reports yet)

Top observed failure modes (ranked by impact x frequency)
1) Hallucination escalation in Rerank prompts (most severe): model invents non-existent product specs for structured comparisons. Triggers: long context (>2k tokens) + quantized weights.
2) Truncation-related incoherence (medium freq): prefix caching + chunking logic leading to misaligned roles in chat history.
3) Tokenization mismatch on special characters (low freq, noisy): URLs and markdown bullets produce inconsistent log-likelihoods, causing reranker to prefer verbose outputs.
4) P95 latency regression for small-batch endpoints when KV-cache disabled (operational regression).

Representative promptset excerpts (examples we used to repro)
- RERANK-A-032: "Compare these two product specs and pick the more accurate — Product A: battery 4Ah, Product B: battery 48Ah. Provide rationale."  -> model invents measurements, flips units.
- ONBOARD-CHAT-109: multi-turn accounting question with code block and inline tables. Model truncates the code block and produces malformed JSON.
- EDGE-URL-014: prompt containing long list of bullet markdown with links — model merges bullets and creates single paragraph.

Initial Triage Notes (what we tried so far)
- Replayed failing promptsets against v2-qd (non-quantized) and v2-qdq (quantized) — delta indicates quantization introduces hallucination artifacts on long context.
- Added tokenization normalization step (strip zero-width spaces) to preprocessor — reduced one-off URL failures but not core Rerank hallucination.
- Instrumented per-token logprob traces for failing runs and shipped to S3 for offline inspection (s3://redwood-eval/triage/2026-04-06/).
- Deployed temporary canary routing (10% traffic) to v2-qd with kv-cache warmup; observed improvement in coherence but p95 latency increased.

Hypothesis map
- H1 (primary): Quantization-induced precision loss for attention weights increases over-long-context hallucination. Evidence: reproduces locally when emulating lower-precision matmul on long sequences.
- H2 (secondary): Tokenization boundary bugs in our new sentence-splitter cause context misalignment for multi-turn prompts. Evidence: mismatch trace for ONBOARD-CHAT-109.
- H3 (ops): Autoscaler/queueing behavior for small batches interacts poorly with kv-cache disabled path causing higher latency and dropped context windows.

Immediate remediation plan (next 72 hours)
- A1 (hotfix): Roll v2-qdq back from default serving for rerank routes -> owners: Priya Nair (deploy) + SRE oncall (rollback) -> ETA: 2 hours.
- A2 (investigate): End-to-end quantization diagnostic job (per-layer activation delta + attention-score distribution compare) -> owners: Diego Chen -> ETA: 48 hours.
- A3 (prompt augmentation): Add 120 unit test prompts that exercise long numeric comparisons and code blocks to the Rerank and Onboard sets; add to CI smoke for onboarding -> owners: Samir Patel + applied-ml interns -> ETA: 36 hours.
- A4 (ops tweak): Enable kv-cache warm-up on small-batch path for canary -> owner: SRE -> ETA: 6 hours. Monitor p95 and cost delta.

Backlog / medium-term actions (sprint scope)
- B1: Build a quantization-sensitivity dashboard (per-parameter / per-layer) feeding into Optimize so we can recommend safe quantization profiles per promptset.
- B2: Add tokenization fuzz tests for special unicode markers and markdown-heavy inputs into onboarding eval harness.
- B3: Add a rerank-specific human review queue for weekly samples where auto-eval and human eval disagree by >15 points.

Ownership and comms
- Primary owner (alerts and deploys): Priya Nair (applied-ml)
- Diagnostics and model experiments: Diego Chen (applied-ml)
- Promptset augmentation + CI: Samir Patel (applied-ml)
- SRE contact: Lina Ortega (oncall)
- Slack channel for this incident: #applied-ml-regression (pin: REG-4521)

Open questions / decisions to make
- Q1: Do we permit a temporary routing rule that pins rerank-heavy customers to non-quantized variants for one week? Tradeoff: increased cost vs stability. Decision needed by 2026-04-09 EOD.
- Q2: Should quantization be gated behind a model-level QA job that includes long-context unit promptsets before rollout? (Proposal: yes; need infra support).

Notes to self / loose ideas (working brainstorm)
- Could we instrument a cheap detection heuristic for hallucination spikes based on divergence between reranker and a conservative verifier model? Maybe add a low-cost verifier that flags outputs with low overlap.
- Consider lightweight per-route quantization profiles (do not apply global qconfig). We already have infra to map model variants to routes; extend to qprofiles.

Appendix: quick commands + data locations
- Repro harness: git@github.com:redwood-inference/onboarding-evals.git (branch: regression/qdq-triage)
- Eval results: s3://redwood-eval/triage/2026-04-06/summary.json
- Canary config: infra/canaries/rerank-v2-qd-canary.yaml (PR: #1284)
- Recorded runbook notes: /confluence/onboarding/triage/REG-4521 (see linked_artifacts)

Immediate ask for reviewers:
- Priya: confirm rollback window and post-rollback smoke results in thread by 2026-04-09 18:00 PT.
- Diego: prioritize the per-layer activation diff job and attach sample visualizations to JIRA REG-4521.
- Samir: push the prompt augmentations to onboarding-evals and add them to CI smoke.

End of log.

(Informal — feel free to edit, add raw traces, or drop short notes under the "Notes to self" section. This doc will be the seed for the sprint ticket pack.)
